root_cause: Production Source Snapshot and Production Release Readback already classified tools/ci/** as non-deployable inside the shared Netlify applicability authority, but their push-level paths-ignore lists did not exclude tools/ci/**. Control-plane commits therefore still allocated production runners before being classified as no-op.

prevention.early_admission: Production Source Snapshot and Production Release Readback both ignore tools/ci/** when it is the only changed domain.
prevention.mixed_change_policy: Any non-ignored runtime/site/portal/Netlify-hosted change still admits the production workflow and is classified normally.
